_placeholders.<ms>: microservice slug (used only for per-µservice attestations; all build/provenance references are repo-global)

build_service.evidence_pattern: GitHub Actions hosted runners (.github/workflows/*); no developer-laptop releases

ephemeral_environment.evidence_pattern: GitHub Actions runners are ephemeral per-job; no cached state between builds

isolated.evidence_pattern: .github/workflows/_template-release.yml (per-job isolation; no shared mutable runner state)

parameterless.evidence_pattern: .github/workflows/_template-release.yml (release driven by tag, no manual workflow_dispatch inputs in release path)

hermetic.evidence_pattern: Cargo.lock pinned; rust-toolchain.toml pinned; .github/workflows/release-musl.yml uses pinned image; no network resolution at build time

available.evidence_pattern: .github/workflows/slsa.yml (publishes in-toto provenance attestation per release artifact)

service_generated.evidence_pattern: .github/workflows/slsa.yml uses slsa-github-generator (provenance generated by build service, not by the build itself)

non_falsifiable.evidence_pattern: Ed25519 signing per Bominal ADR-0028 (inherited); Sigstore transparency log entry per release; .github/workflows/cosign.yml

access.evidence_pattern: .github/branch-protection.yaml#restrictions (write access restricted to maintainers + reviewer-agent role)

superusers.evidence_pattern: .github/branch-protection.yaml#enforce_admins=true (admins subject to same protections; no force-push to dev/staging/production)
